Meanwhile the Starter Bundle at 5.01x true ROAS is starved of budget. Reallocating $210 from Cleanser to Bundle and Serum projects +$1,847/week in recovered profit.

reallocation.cfo_narrative: This reallocation is budget-neutral at $1,145/day while projecting a $1,847/week profit improvement — a 23% uplift. The core move is redirecting $210/day from our largest but loss-making campaign (Hydrating Cleanser, true ROAS 0.99x) to our two most underfunded winners: Starter Bundle (5.01x) and Vitamin C Serum (2.94x). We also pre-emptively reduce Retinol Night Cream spend to extend its 12-day inventory runway while sourcing emergency stock.

experiment.hypothesis: Adding UGC social proof imagery to Starter Bundle ad creative will increase CTR by 15% and conversion rate by 8%, lifting true profit ROAS from 5.01x to 5.8x within 14 days.
experiment.control_description: Current Starter Bundle ad: product flatlay image, single headline 'Start Your Glow Journey', standard CTA button.
experiment.variant_description: New creative: UGC before/after skin transformation photo, headline 'Join 12,000 GlowNest customers', social proof sub-copy '4.8 stars from 3,200 reviews', urgency CTA 'Get the Bundle'.
experiment.rationale: Starter Bundle has the highest true ROAS (5.01x) and is being scaled from $95 to $245/day. Improving creative performance during scale-up compounds returns. Social proof is the highest-leverage lever for bundle products.

optimization.executive_summary: Six targeted improvements identified across creative, bidding, and audience strategy. Priority focus: fix Hydrating Cleanser return rate (root cause of negative ROAS) and unlock Starter Bundle audience expansion. Combined impact: +$2,340/week.

suggestions.title: Fix product page — 34% return rate is destroying margins
suggestions.description: A 34% return rate is the root cause of this campaign's negative profit ROAS. The product page is setting incorrect expectations about scent, texture, or usage. No amount of ad optimisation fixes a broken post-purchase experience.
suggestions.expected_impact: Reducing return rate from 34% to 15% would push true ROAS from 0.99x to 2.1x — converting your worst campaign into a solid mid-performer.
action_steps: Audit recent 1-star reviews for return reason patterns
Add texture, scent description and 'best for' skin type to product page
Add a short video showing correct application amount
A/B test revised product page with detailed expectation-setting copy
Add post-purchase email with usage tips to reduce return likelihood

suggestions.title: Build lookalike audience from Starter Bundle purchasers
suggestions.description: With true ROAS of 5.01x, the Starter Bundle has a proven high-value customer profile. A 1% lookalike from purchasers dramatically improves top-of-funnel efficiency as you scale from $95 to $245/day.
suggestions.expected_impact: Lookalike audiences improve conversion rate 20-35% vs broad targeting. At 5.01x base ROAS, even a 20% improvement yields major incremental profit.
action_steps: Export Starter Bundle purchaser list (min 500 customers) from Shopify
Upload to Google Ads as a Customer Match audience
Create a 1% Similar Audience based on purchaser list
Launch separate ad group targeting lookalike only with $80/day budget
Compare CPA and ROAS vs broad targeting after 7 days

suggestions.title: Add ingredient-led creative as you scale Vitamin C Serum
suggestions.description: As you scale from $180 to $320/day, creative fatigue accelerates. Ingredient-led ads (20% Vitamin C, dermatologist-tested) perform 2-3x better in skincare vs lifestyle imagery.
suggestions.expected_impact: Fresh ingredient-led creative during scale-up protects ROAS. Estimated 10-15% CTR improvement.
action_steps: Brief designer on 3 static ads: ingredient close-up, before/after, scientific claim
Add '20% Vitamin C concentration' and 'Dermatologist tested' copy overlays
Test against current creative in 50/50 split for 7 days
Pause underperformer, scale winner

suggestions.title: Emergency reorder — only 12 days inventory remaining
suggestions.description: A stockout causes campaign suspension, Quality Score drops, and weeks of ramp-up time. Rush reorder now while reducing spend to extend runway.
suggestions.expected_impact: Preventing stockout avoids an estimated $2,800+ in lost revenue and 3-4 week campaign recovery.
action_steps: Place emergency reorder with supplier today — request air freight if needed
Reduce campaign spend from $290 to $210/day to extend runway to 17 days
Set up inventory alert at 30-day threshold going forward
Prepare paused campaign drafts ready to reactivate on restock

suggestions.title: Switch SPF Moisturizer to Target ROAS bidding
suggestions.description: SPF Moisturizer is stable with consistent true ROAS around 2.0x. Switching to Target ROAS bidding at 350% allows Google to optimise for higher-value conversions automatically.
suggestions.expected_impact: Target ROAS bidding typically improves conversion value 8-15% over manual CPC on established campaigns.
action_steps: Verify campaign has 30+ conversions in last 30 days
Set Target ROAS to 350% (current reported ROAS baseline)
Monitor for 2-week learning period — do not change bids
Adjust target up/down 10% based on actual ROAS achieved

suggestions.title: Add negative keywords to cut irrelevant Bundle traffic
suggestions.description: Bundle products attract deal-seekers with low purchase intent. Negative keywords (free, cheap, DIY, sample) improve traffic quality and conversion rate.
suggestions.expected_impact: Negative keyword optimisation reduces wasted spend 8-12% while maintaining conversion volume.
action_steps: Pull Search Terms report for last 30 days in Google Ads
Flag all terms with 0 conversions and 5+ clicks
Add irrelevant terms as exact/phrase negatives
Add broad negatives: free, cheap, diy, sample, homemade
Review search terms report weekly going forward
